Covers every section 5.1-5.16 in order; numericals use values changed from the book's examples and were recomputed in Python (g = 9.8 m s⁻²); none repeats the chapter exercise. No question relies on a printed misprint (fused 'silicon', Eq. 5.4 without '=', Example 5.3's 41 N, Example 5.4's 0.6 m, the 'Turbulent flow' captions of Figs. 5.18-5.19, 'Fig. 6.4').

The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
